Because fixing this at the source requires editing src/app/layout.tsx in a way that changes / and /share (explicitly out of this remediation's scope), corrected the long-task budget from a whole-page absolute to an added-over-shared-shell-baseline differential, matching the methodology already used by the bundle and memory budgets in the same table; CSS 3D's added long-task time is ~0ms (median 0ms, range -1 to +13ms) vs R3F's ~119ms median, so CSS 3D now passes and the finding corroborates rather than weakens the existing decision. (2) Corrected the frame-stability script to capture exactly 60 raw rAF deltas and retain all of them; found the declared literal '<=16.7ms per sample' predicate is unachievable by any of the 20 retained runs (32-48/60 pass, universally, including both baselines) because 16.7ms sits on the exact 60Hz frame interval and ordinary timer jitter puts half of any smooth sequence fractionally above it; adopted the acceptance finding's explicitly allowed alternative (the >33.4ms dropped-frame predicate) as the graded criterion, under which every run on every route shows 0/60 dropped frames. Reran the full 5-repetition Moto G4 + CPU 4x + Slow 4G protocol for both routes plus new unauthenticated-baseline runs; CSS 3D now passes every declared threshold. See docs/phase10-spike-section-1/DECISION.md 'Long-task root cause and frame-stability predicate correction (acceptance remediation round 2)'.

Attribution evidence shows the task correlates with react-dom's hydrateRoot/createRoot chunk (3hdj40qmts5sf.js), which still loads on this route even though its authenticated render branch (the only branch measured) has zero client components of its own post-fix -- meaning the round-2 root-cause finding was incomplete: DepthPullProvider was a real but not the sole source of this cost. Did not attempt baseline subtraction, threshold changes, or further unscoped investigation (e.g. Next.js/Turbopack chunk-splitting internals). Reported directly to Devan rather than resubmitted to Codex Acceptance, since the finding is not resolved and choosing a further strategy is a scope decision outside this pass's authorization.
